description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 
Consultant, Stars Consulting Center of Excellence

Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, we help organizations understand people’s experiences and use those insights to drive meaningful clinical, operational, and quality improvements. Following the integration of Press Ganey into Qualtrics, our Stars Consulting Center of Excellence brings together deep healthcare expertise and industry-leading experience management capabilities. As a Medicare Stars Consultant, you’ll be a hands-on practitioner who builds the analyses and deliverables powering consulting engagements across CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, medication adherence, and operational measures. Working directly with health plans, medical groups, and consulting colleagues, you’ll identify performance gaps, execute complex workstreams independently, and help clients improve the experiences and outcomes of their Medicare Advantage members.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Turn analysis into action: Go beyond reporting results to personally execute deep-dive analytics, explain what’s driving performance, and build practical recommendations clients can implement.
  • Take ownership as a hands-on doer: Clarify the expected outcome, gather the right context, and drive complex workstreams and deliverables forward independently with minimal oversight.
  • Make complex information clear: Translate CMS Stars requirements, technical measure specifications, and analytical findings into compelling stories and recommendations different audiences can understand.
  • Build trusted relationships: Serve as a direct, credible point of contact for client workstreams—listening closely, following through on commitments, and communicating progress, risks, and recommendations early.
  • Stay focused as priorities shift: Balance multiple high-demand client engagements and tight deadlines while maintaining high analytical quality and attention to detail.
  • Help others learn: Create and deliver engaging training that gives health plan teams the knowledge and confidence to apply Stars and member experience best practices.
  • Work collaboratively: Bring together the right internal resources (including Qualtrics/Press Ganey data assets and Hyperlift analytics) and client stakeholders, establish clear responsibilities, and keep delivery moving.

How You’ll Grow

  • Deepen your expertise across Medicare Stars measures and the connections between member experience, clinical quality, and health outcomes.
  • Strengthen your end-to-end consulting skills through autonomous, client-facing data execution, executive presentations, training, and relationship management.
  • Expand your ability to translate CMS guidance, rate announcements, and technical changes into practical client strategies.
  • Develop your ability to integrate member experience insights (CAHPS/HOS) with clinical quality and operational analytics platforms like Hyperlift to inform high-impact improvement decisions.

Things You’ll Do

  • Construct and lead measure-level analytics: Help clients focus on their highest-impact Stars opportunities by executing measure-level performance trending, cut point and gap analyses, and member experience driver analyses across CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, medication adherence, and operational measures.
  • Design achievable improvement plans: Partner with health plans and medical groups to assess clinical and operational processes, interpret data to identify underlying problems, and recommend targeted interventions.
  • Manage end-to-end workstream delivery: Deliver engagements that meet agreed expectations by managing defined scopes, work plans, timelines, deliverables, budgets, and outcomes while coordinating internal and client resources.
  • Lead client-ready deliverable creation: Build client confidence in decisions and next steps by serving as the direct contact for assigned workstreams and personally preparing data analyses, assessments, quality reviews, and executive presentations.
  • Deliver training and knowledge transfer: Help clients sustain improvements by designing and leading training sessions on Stars, member experience best practices, and process improvement.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and integrate insights: Keep client recommendations current and evidence-based by tracking CMS guidance, rate announcements, and technical specification updates, and integrating Stars analyses with Hyperlift analytics and CAHPS/HOS survey insights.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Hands-on experience supporting Medicare Advantage quality, Star Ratings, or member experience work, typically developed through 2+ years in a health plan quality/analytics role or healthcare consulting environment.
  • Demonstrated contributions to performance improvement initiatives with health plan stakeholders, including the specific programs you owned, analytical actions you took, and measurable outcomes you produced.
  • Direct experience in one or more of these areas:
    • HEDIS operations and rate improvement, including measure specifications, supplemental data, and medical record review.
    • CAHPS and member experience improvement across lines of business.
    • Medication adherence and Part D measures.
    • HOS and health outcomes measurement.
    • Government programs and quality requirements associated with Medicare Stars and NCQA.
  • Strong quantitative and data analysis skills using tools such as Excel, Access, SQL, or SAS, with proven ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations.
  • Experience independently producing clear, client-ready documents and executive presentations, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Evidence of managing multiple competing priorities, meeting strict deadlines, and adapting quickly to changing client requirements.
  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • Strongly preferred: Experience with Special Needs Plans—D-SNP, C-SNP, or I-SNP—including their specific quality, compliance, and member experience considerations.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We are a high-impact, hands-on consulting team focused on helping clients act on their data—not simply delivering static reports.
  • Our work integrates member experience, health plan quality, and Medicare Stars performance within our Stars Consulting Center of Excellence to solve complex problems from multiple angles.
  • We collaborate directly with major health plans and medical groups, grounding recommendations in their operational realities and member needs.
  • You’ll join a fast-paced, growing practice experiencing strong market demand, offering immediate ownership of meaningful client engagements and close collaboration with senior consulting leaders.
  • This role is remote within the United States, with up to 50% travel as needed to support key client engagements.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • 100% Performance based promotions -- not politics or tenure
  • Culture - Incredible work environment - you can wear jeans and bring your dog to the office, anytime
  • Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote
